cultural.vision_reason: The image shows an elaborate metal figurine or ritual vessel with human and bird figures, consistent with Fon Benin metalwork and sculpture. It plausibly represents an object made or used within Fon culture.

physical.title: figurine
physical.summary: Figurine (with lid); made of metal; a) figurine: circle of wood for base, with three small circles nailed on bottom for feet; three women kneeling, facing outward, screwed onto base, arms stretched out behind them, each wearing skirt (one etched with flowers, the other two with curvilinear designs); the women support a round bowl with vertical neck at centre, etched on outside with pot designs and crosshatched areas; three pieces of metal nailed to side of bowl, each swooping out toward head of woman and then up and dividing into two leaves; bird stands, one foot on each leaf, back incised with geometric designs; b) lid: round circle of metal with metal lip on bottom to insert inside neck of bowl of figurine; knob with raised lines on top; sides of bowl etched with curvilinear designs and cross-hatched areas, and three triangle-shaped holes with circle-shaped holes above.
